AC198-6: Any reusable source change preserves host-neutral typed diagnostic/failure contracts consumable by existing internal_diagnostics/Palmistry adapters. Reuse canonical watcher/source proof and do not embed a copied watcher/controller/restart mechanism inside renderer or GUI source.
